name: Hollow body hold

technique.setup: Lie on your back, arms overhead and legs straight. Press the lower back into the floor, then lift shoulders and legs just off the ground.
cues: Press the lower back into the floor
Ribs down, chin slightly tucked
Point the toes and squeeze the legs together
Bend the knees to make it easier
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor
Legs so low the back arches
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck strain that doesn't ease when you tuck the chin

media.searchHint: Antranik hollow body hold tutorial progression

notes: Regress by bending the knees or bringing the arms to the sides. Gate test for front lever (30 s).

technique.setup: Get into a hollow body hold with the lower back pressed into the floor. Rock from the shoulder blades to the hips without changing the shape.
cues: Keep the hollow shape locked
Rock from the shoulders to the hips
Lower back stays on the floor
mistakes: Bending at the hips to create the rock
Lower back arching at the end of the rock
Throwing the arms to build momentum
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Losing the shape on every rep

media.searchHint: GMB Fitness hollow body rock tutorial

technique.setup: Lie face down with arms overhead and legs straight. Lift chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor and hold.
cues: Squeeze the glutes first
Lift long, not high
Keep the neck neutral, eyes on the floor
mistakes: Lifting as high as possible and crunching the lower back
stopIf: Sharp or pinching pain in the lower back
Numbness or tingling in the legs

name: Dead bug

technique.setup: Lie on your back with arms pointing to the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips. Press the lower back into the floor.
cues: Press the lower back into the floor
Reach the opposite arm and leg away slowly
Breathe out as you reach
mistakes: Lower back lifting as the leg extends
Moving the arm and leg on the same side
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back or hips

notes: Count each side as one rep.

name: Forearm plank

technique.setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, legs straight with toes tucked. Make a straight line from head to heels.
cues: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes
Push the floor away with the forearms
Breathe steadily
mistakes: Shoulders sinking between the shoulder blades
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back or shoulder
Pinching at the front of the shoulder

notes: Regress by dropping to the knees.

name: Side plank

technique.setup: Lie on one side with the elbow under the shoulder and legs stacked. Lift the hips so the body makes a straight line.
cues: Stack the elbow under the shoulder
Push the hips up and forward
Keep a straight line from head to feet
stopIf: Sharp pain or pinching in the supporting shoulder
Sharp pain in the lower back or hips

notes: Regress by bending the bottom knee and resting it on the floor.

technique.setup: Hang from the bar with a shoulder-width grip and straight arms. Pull the shoulders down slightly so you're in an active hang.
cues: Pull the shoulders down, no swinging
Curl the knees up toward the chest
Lower slowly and stop the swing
mistakes: Hanging passively with shoulders by the ears
stopIf: Sharp or pinching pain in the shoulder
Grip giving out: step down instead of dropping

media.searchHint: Calisthenicmovement hanging knee raise tutorial beginner

name: Hanging leg raise

technique.setup: Hang from the bar in an active hang with straight arms. Keep the legs together and straight.
cues: Pull the shoulders down, no swinging
Lift straight legs to hip height or higher
Lower slowly with control
mistakes: Swinging to get the legs up
Bending the knees to cheat the top
stopIf: Sharp or pinching pain in the shoulder
Sharp pain in the lower back or hip flexors

notes: 10 controlled reps is the gate for the dragon flag tree.

name: V-up

technique.setup: Lie on your back in a hollow body position, arms overhead and legs straight. Lift arms and legs together to meet over the hips.
cues: Start from a hollow body
Reach the hands to the toes
Lower slowly back to the hollow
mistakes: Lower back arching at the bottom
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck pain

notes: Bend the knees (tuck-up) to make it easier.

name: Seated compression leg lift

technique.setup: Sit tall with legs straight together and hands resting lightly on the floor beside the knees. Lift both heels a few centimetres off the floor.
cues: Sit tall, chest up
Lift with the thighs, not by leaning back
Point the toes and keep the knees straight
mistakes: Leaning back to get the legs up
stopIf: Cramping or sharp pain in the hip flexors
Sharp pain in the lower back

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs seated leg lifts compression L-sit

notes: Builds the compression strength the L-sit tree needs.

technique.setup: Stand between the dip-station handles, grip them and lock the arms. Sit back so the heels stay on the floor in front of you and lift the hips off the floor.
cues: Push down through the handles
Depress the shoulders, long neck
Keep the arms locked straight
Let the heels carry only a little weight
mistakes: Putting most of the weight through the feet
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the wrist or elbow
Pinching at the front of the shoulder

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs L-sit progression parallel bars beginner

technique.setup: Grip the dip-station handles and lock the arms. Lift both feet off the floor and pull the knees up toward the chest.
cues: Push down through the handles
Depress the shoulders, long neck
Knees to chest
Point the toes
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the wrist or elbow
Pinching at the front of the shoulder

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs tuck L-sit parallettes dip bars tutorial

name: One-leg L-sit

technique.setup: From a tuck L-sit on the dip-station handles, straighten one leg in front at hip height while the other knee stays tucked. Switch the straight leg each set.
cues: Push down through the handles
Depress the shoulders, long neck
Point the toes of the straight leg
Keep the tucked knee to the chest
mistakes: Straight leg sagging below the hips
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the wrist or elbow
Pinching at the front of the shoulder
Hip flexor cramp

notes: Alternate the straight leg between sets so both sides get equal time.

technique.setup: Grip the dip-station handles, lock the arms and lift both straight legs to hip height. Hold with the legs together.
cues: Push down through the handles
Depress the shoulders, long neck
Point the toes, knees locked
Squeeze the thighs up toward the chest
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the wrist or elbow
Pinching at the front of the shoulder
Hip flexor cramp

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs perfect L-sit tutorial dip bars

name: V-sit

technique.setup: From a full L-sit on the dip-station handles, lean the shoulders slightly back and lift the straight legs above hip height into a V.
cues: Push down through the handles
Depress the shoulders, long neck
Point the toes and lift the legs high
Keep the arms locked straight
mistakes: Bending the knees to get the legs higher
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the wrist, elbow or shoulder
Pinching at the front of the shoulder
Hip flexor or hamstring cramp

notes: Needs good pike flexibility; pair with seated-pike work.

name: Dragon flag tuck negative

technique.setup: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head. Roll up onto the upper back with knees tucked, then lower over 3-5 s until the hips touch the bench.
cues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck
Keep a straight line from shoulders to hips
Lower slowly over 3-5 s
Stop lowering as soon as the lower back starts to arch
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck pain or pressure
Pinching in the shoulder

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs dragon flag progression tuck negative

notes: Tree gate: 10 hanging leg raises. Lower only as far as the straight line holds.

technique.setup: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head. Roll up onto the upper back with straight legs spread wide, then lower over 3-5 s.
cues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck
Keep a straight line from shoulders to feet
Lower slowly over 3-5 s
Stop lowering as soon as the lower back starts to arch
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck pain or pressure
Pinching in the shoulder

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs dragon flag straddle negative progression

technique.setup: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head. Roll up onto the upper back with legs straight and together, then lower over 3-5 s.
cues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck
Keep a straight line from shoulders to toes
Lower slowly over 3-5 s
Stop lowering as soon as the lower back starts to arch
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck pain or pressure
Pinching in the shoulder

technique.setup: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head. Roll up onto the upper back with straight legs, lower under control and raise back up without bending at the hips.
cues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck
Keep a straight line from shoulders to toes
Lower only as far as the line holds
Raise and lower as one rigid piece
mistakes: Piking at the hips on the way up
stopIf: Sharp pain in the lower back
Neck pain or pressure
Pinching in the shoulder
